tools.name: browser_context
tools.description: Open or close a browser for this agent. "fresh" starts with an empty throwaway profile and uses the legacy CLI outside copied-profile protection. "mine" makes a private Edge/Chrome copy without saved-login stores or linked files, retaining qualified single-link cookie/encryption metadata. Its owned native producer hides all input/textarea/editable and unknown-region values, refuses raw commands, and initially supports only one main document with qualified light-DOM actions. Both run in the background without touching the person's open windows. Keep contextId, and close when done; closing deletes the private folder.

action.description: open starts a new browser and returns its contextId; close shuts it and deletes its folder.

browser.description: open only. fresh: initially empty legacy profile. mine: protected private copy with restricted native output/actions, deleted on close. Defaults to fresh.

contextId.description: close only. The contextId that open returned.

tools.name: browser_command
tools.description: Run a command in an owned browser context. args is a list of literal strings, never shell or user JavaScript. Start with ["goto","https://example.com"] or ["snapshot"], then use current refs with click/fill/type/press/select/check/uncheck/hover. In mine, owned native output always redacts protected values; eval/run-code/raw storage/network/console and native screenshot/PDF exports are refused. ["snapshot","--save"] writes only a sanitized owner-named JSON artifact; raw/JSON/filename opt-outs are unavailable. Child frames, closed shadows, stale refs and unqualified output are refused; an action may have applied before post-action output fails. Fresh retains legacy CLI commands outside the copied-profile boundary. Open/close only through browser_context.

contextId.description: The contextId that browser_context open returned.

args.description: The command and its arguments, for example ["snapshot"] or ["fill","e4","text"].
